thread:
tabitha: hitting quota errors provisioning 8x ND40rs in francecentral, trying to spin up staging fleet and API returns `Standard_ND40rs_v2` quota exceeded. Subscription is 7a3d-9f2b-4c1e-aaaa. Raised support ticket CS2201123456 but wanted to sync here before escalating TAM.
joel: yep same. I tried portal quota increase -> it asked for vCPUs in region category, submitted but portal shows 'Under review'. Azure chat said region capacity limited for ND40rs.
ivan: fyi ND-series are running tight in francecentral right now. Two options: (1) request quota + ask for capacity reservation (private capacity) or (2) fallback to NDv2 in westeurope temporarily.
chloe: are we blocked by subnet/NSG too? last time an onboarding failed because of port restrictions on the compute subnet. can someone paste `az vm create` error? 
tabitha: error snippet pasted below:
```
Provisioning failed with quotaExceeded: Requested cores exceeds subscription limit for cores in region 'francecentral'.
```
sam: check subscription type — CSP subscriptions can't always use capacity reservations; EA or PAYG with reservation entitlement needed. Which subscription is this? 
tabitha: it's an internal PAYG trial account we use for staging (7a3d-9f2b-4c1e-aaaa). I included that in the support ticket.
joel: I started a parallel request for a temporary reservation with support — asked them to allocate 8 ND40rs or equivalent capacity in neighboring region if FR is impossible. referenced ticket CS2201123456 and internal INF-639.
ivan: if support won't reserve, we can open an Azure SKUs/Quota change request and set a fallback routing policy in our deploy pipeline to use `westeurope` NDv2. I'll add a canary flag in the infra repo.
tabitha: created infra PR to add fallback region: branch `infra/nd-fallback-fr`. Also added quick check in bootstrap: `if quota < required then switch-region westeurope`.
chloe: also verify Accelerated Networking and target VMSS SKU mapping. ND40rs requires specific VMSS SKU mapping; mismatch will fail silently.
sre-bot: Capacity reservation job started for subscription 7a3d-9f2b-4c1e-aaaa, request id resv-2026-03-15-77
azure-support-bot: Update on CS2201123456: FRANCECENTRAL capacity constrained for ND40rs. We can provision after quota increase but physical capacity availability ETA ~72 hours or suggest alternate region. If you need guaranteed throughput please request a Dedicated Reserved capacity (Capacity Reservation) and provide workload start window.
tabitha: thanks. action items: Joel will follow up with TAM for reservation (owner: joel). Ivan will land fallback region PR and update pipeline (owner: ivan). Chloe will validate subnet/NSG rules and VMSS mapping (owner: chloe). Sam will confirm subscription entitlement for reservations (owner: sam).
joel: pinged TAM and included PR links + internal INF-639. Azure asked for expected sustained GPU hours per month so they can prioritize — I provided ~6k GPU hours.
tabitha: adding cost note — if we reserve capacity for 3 months it's estimated additional $12k/month vs burst on-demand which is unpredictable. we'll table cost approval until sales OKs staging spend.
ivan: temporary plan: try westeurope NDv2 until FR capacity clears. I'll also add instrumentation to console to flag quota failures per-subscription.
chloe: I'll run quick NSG/route checks and report back in this thread within the hour.
sre-bot: reminder: infra ticket INF-639 due EOD for follow-ups.
azure-support-bot: CS2201123456 updated: Support assigned to TAM Yves. Next update ETA 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. If you can provide subscription RID and preferred start window, add to the ticket.
tabitha: added start window (2026-03-20 02:00-05:00 UTC) and subscription RID to the ticket. keeping thread updated.
joel: marking this as in-flight, will escalate to TAM if no reply by 36h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
chloe: NSG/VMSS quick check done — nothing obvious blocking, can proceed once quota/reservation approved. pasted small command we used to check vCPUs:
```
az vm list-usage --location francecentral --subscription 7a3d-9f2b-4c1e-aaaa
```
tabitha: great, thanks everyone. I'll close the loop here after azure support confirms or we cutover to westeurope.
